stories.title: NASA Delivers Navigation System for Commercial Lunar Relay
stories.summary: NASA delivered the NavCube3-mini payload on July 13 to Intuitive Machines for integration into Altus-1, the company’s first lunar relay satellite, marking an important milestone in the development of future lunar communications and navigation services. The lunar relays are designed to enable communications and navigation for astronauts and rovers operating at the agency’s future Moon Base. stories.title: Perrystead Dairy Cheese Vending Machine in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
stories.summary: In the East Kensington neighborhood of Philadelphia, the Perrystead Dairy Vending Machine looks like something fairies dropped in the middle of a magic garden—and to the cheese enthusiasts of the area it might as well have been. It’s surrounded by expertly cultivated native flora, bisected by a curving stone path. If it weren’t for the sound of the El train roaring by in the distance, you might think you were somehow transported far from the city limits. Perrystead is a local cheese shop unlike any other. With a small team of four, they make over 500 pounds of cheese a week. They keep their repertoire small, less than ten different cheeses, some of them seasonal, developed over time and inspired by a blend of old European techniques and American innovation. They have reached international acclaim and are world title holders; the winners of many a cheese competition.
